About this Event

I'M THAT GIRLLLL! 💗
A Movement, Wellness & Activewear Pop-Up
She's confident. She's sexy. She's focused. She knows she can do ALL the things — because she's THAT GIRL!
Join Think Better Feel Better × Tht Grl Activewear for an empowering afternoon of movement, shopping, and sisterhood!
✨ Intentional yoga flow
✨ Relaxing sound healing
✨ Shop Tht Grl Activewear's collection
✨ Connect, commune & embrace your THAT GRL energy!
📅 Saturday, October 17, 2026
⏰ 11:45 AM – 1:45 PM
📍 The Bodi Shop | 8754 S Stony Island Ave, Chicago, IL
Tickets are limited! 
Limited mats available. 
Bring your yoga mat if you have one and come ready to move, and leave feeling like THAT GIRLLLL! 🫰🏽
*****If you already have Tht Grl Activewear Come dressed in yours for a chance to win a prize 🎁

Also check out other in Chicago, Health & Wellness events in Chicago.
